title: The drop, round 2: the cut's first 5 s cannot be skipped and then only Space skips it (with a SPACE · SKIP hint); the Ridgebacks walk on the demo's procedural gait with claws anchored where they land, at 0.08 cells/s instead of a sliding clip at 0.25
context: Owner, 2026-10-23 10:40 JST, second test of the FEIDS-26 drop: '1) it is too easy to skip the animation without meaning to, let's have the first 5 seconds mandatory, then a skip with spacebar is feasible. 4) the Mechs style glide too much in their locomotion, the https://jelaludo.github.io/SentryTowers_A6/ridgeback-mech/ default animation does it better; no gliding, feeling of heaviness.' Spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-drop-round-2-design.md (decisions, not reopened); demo sources in the vault (stalheart-feids26-peek: assets_ridgeback-mech_runtime.js, ridgeback-mech_behavior.js). Built overnight on branch drop-round-2 from overnight-2026-10-23, not pushed.
outcome: Note 1: src/fx/camera-shot.js start() takes lockFor (seconds of the shot's own age when nothing skips) and skipKey (after the lock only that key; taps never); such a shot eats the gestures it does not obey (a screenshot chord passes, a card's own button keeps its tap) so a stray key neither skips nor reaches the game. Other shots unchanged. The drop's cut passes REINFORCEMENTS.shot.lock 5 and skipKey ' '; from the lock's end to the cut's end the host shows 'SPACE · SKIP' at the bottom centre in the gunship briefing footer's markup and colours (#feids-skip-hint). Note 4: new src/fx/mech-gait.js ports the demo's gait (LEGS, STANCE_DUTY 0.72, UPPER/LOWER, DURATION 4, policy(0), walkSpeed 0.2778 m/s, poseLeg, solveHydraulics, the body bob and roll; not the gun lines) with its heaviness rule (a stance claw anchored at the world point where it landed, a swing foot leaving its anchor over (1-q)^2), the phase at rate = ground speed / (0.2778 x 0.75). src/fx/mech-squad.js drops the Walk_Cycle clip (still in the GLB) and the landing clip at the adoption and poses each hidden rig with it; the instancing and far tier unchanged. REINFORCEMENTS.pace 0.25 -> 0.08 cells/s (0.8 m/s, rate 3.84, a leg cycle 1.04 s), gaitCap gone. Choices the spec left open: standing still reaches the park pose by stepping in place (stride 0) until every leg has swung and all six are down (no foot jumps to the park pose); a parked body turning for its minigun steps in place; the walking heading turns at 0.6 rad/s instead of snapping at each cell; the adoption keeps the landing's facing (it used to snap to the frame's z); a claw keeps its landing orientation through its stance and turns back over its swing; the tap no longer skips the drop, so a phone waits the full 28 s. The base mech's march: 249 hops from the drop (263 from the heart) to its park (14) at 10 m a hop is 3,112 s, about 52 game minutes at 0.08 cells/s (about 17 at 0.25): the owner weighs the pace against the look.
alternatives: Keeping Walk_Cycle at a matched rate: the clip's own ground speed (0.2778 m/s at rate 1) would need a rate of 12 at 0.25 cells/s, and any clip on a turning, path-following body slides its claws; the anchors make sliding impossible by construction.
Snapping the feet to the park pose when a mech stops (the demo's park mode): a visible jump of up to half a stride; stepping in place costs about 1.3 s and never slides.
Keeping the tap as a skip after the lock (phones have no Space): the spec says taps do not skip; left for the owner.
Keeping the in-cut draw-call A/B at drop t 24 s in --reinforcements: the cut now ends at 6.9 s on Space, so the four's draw cost is read up close (reinforce-near) only.
evidence: npm test 304 programs (new: mech-gait; camera-shot-skip, mech-squad, reinforcements updated), npm run check (td-tab 5,322 under 5,450), npm run architecture, npm run build: green on the final tree.

test/mech-gait.mjs: three claws down at 4000 phases; 10 s at rate 3.8 moves the body 7.93 m with every planted claw constant to 1e-9 and 54 landings at the body's new target (largest last-swing-to-anchor step 11.3 mm); parks in 1.33 s at the park pose; a parked 0.8 rad/s turn slides nothing.

--reinforcements (port 18184): a plain K at drop t 2.34 s leaves the cut, no hint; at 6.12 s the hint stands; K at 6.6 s still leaves it; Space at 6.92 s ends it, lens put back, hint node gone; touchdowns 13.02 / 13.45 / 14.01 / 19.25 s, 10 of 10 cues voiced; the hunter's gait over 30 s after the landing: 115 samples, contacts min 3, 107 steady walking samples at rate 3.84 for a measured 0.784..0.800 m/s, worst 2.0 % off speed / (0.2778 x 0.75); base mech heart 263 -> 260 in 30 s, park at 14; PASS through reinforce-arena.
--reinforcements-lull PASS (dropping at a lull after the due day, four landed).

--feids-shots PASS, frames 3 / 7 / 13 / 17 / 19.6 / 22 s as before plus artifacts/browser/feids-40.png: the base mech walking on its game tier 12 m from a 3/4-front look (rate 3.84, three claws down), the legs reaching the floor at a wide stance with the claws planted and the body low and level; a still cannot show the cadence. The first try froze the world (mechLook was not in td-tab's live-shot list): the frame showed the mechs on their far tier, stopped; fixed.
